From **“The Battle (George Jones song)”**, George Jones released **“The Battle”** in **1976**, and that same year **“Golden Ring,” a duet with his estranged ex-wife Tammy Wynette, became a #1 hit**. From **“Tammy Wynette”**, Tammy Wynette was **born May 5, 1942** and was an **American country music singer-songwriter**.

Therefore, the singer-songwriter born in May 1942 who sang a duet with her ex-husband that same year was **Tammy Wynette**.
